species.name: Rowlet
species.flavor: Flies noiselessly on delicate wings. It has mastered the art of deftly launching dagger-sharp feathers from those same wings.

species.name: Dartrix
species.flavor: Regularly basks in sunlight to gather power—presumably due to the frigid climate. Nonetheless, the edges of the blade quills set into its wings are keen as ever.

species.name: Decidueye
species.flavor: The air stored inside the rachises of Decidueye's feathers insulates the Pokémon against Hisui's extreme cold. This is firm proof that evolution can be influenced by environment.

species.name: Litten
species.flavor: Trying to pet Litten before it trusts you will result in a nasty scratch from its sharp claws. Be careful.

species.name: Torracat
species.flavor: When facing a powerful enemy, Torracat’s fighting spirit gets pumped up, and its fire bell blazes hotter.

species.name: Incineroar
species.flavor: Incineroar’s rough and aggressive behavior is its most notable trait, but the way it helps out small Pokémon shows that it has a kind side as well.

species.name: Popplio
species.flavor: If Popplio want to create big, powerful balloons, they must be persistent. It takes daily practice for these Pokémon to develop their skills.

species.name: Brionne
species.flavor: On nights when the sea is calm, Brionne dance with one another to the singing of the Primarina that’s leading them.

species.name: Primarina
species.flavor: For Primarina, every battle’s a stage. Its singing and the dancing of its balloons will mesmerize the audience.

species.name: Pikipek
species.flavor: It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a tree 16 times per second!

species.name: Trumbeak
species.flavor: From its mouth, it fires the seeds of berries it has eaten. The scattered seeds give rise to new plants.

species.name: Toucannon
species.flavor: Known for forming harmonious couples, this Pokémon is brought to wedding ceremonies as a good luck charm.

species.name: Yungoos
species.flavor: Although it will eat anything, it prefers fresh living things, so it marches down streets in search of prey.

species.name: Gumshoos
species.flavor: Patient by nature, this Pokémon loses control of itself and pounces when it spots its favorite meal—Rattata!

species.name: Grubbin
species.flavor: It uses its big jaws to dig nests into the forest floor, and it loves to feed on sweet tree sap.

species.name: Charjabug
species.flavor: Its digestive processes convert the leaves it eats into electricity. An electric sac in its belly stores the electricity for later use.

species.name: Vikavolt
species.flavor: If it carries a Charjabug to use as a spare battery, a flying Vikavolt can rapidly fire high-powered beams of electricity.

species.name: Crabrawler
species.flavor: Crabrawler has been known to mistake Exeggutor for a coconut tree and climb it. The enraged Exeggutor shakes it off and stomps it.

species.name: Crabominable
species.flavor: Before it stops to think, it just starts pummeling. There are records of its turning back avalanches with a flurry of punches.

species.name: Oricorio
species.flavor: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.

species.name: Cutiefly
species.flavor: An opponent’s aura can tell Cutiefly what that opponent’s next move will be. Then Cutiefly can glide around the attack and strike back.

species.name: Ribombee
species.flavor: Ribombee absolutely hate getting wet or rained on. In the cloudy Galar region, they are very seldom seen.

species.name: Rockruff
species.flavor: This Pokémon intimidates opponents by striking the ground with the rocks on its neck. The moment an opponent flinches, Rockruff attacks.

species.name: Lycanroc
species.flavor: With swift movements, this Pokémon gradually backs its prey into a corner. Lycanroc’s fangs are always aimed toward opponents’ weak spots.

species.name: Wishiwashi
species.flavor: When it senses danger, its eyes tear up. The sparkle of its tears signals other Wishiwashi to gather.

species.name: Mareanie
species.flavor: Unlike their Alolan counterparts, the Mareanie of the Galar region have not yet figured out that the branches of Corsola are delicious.

species.name: Toxapex
species.flavor: Within the poison sac in its body is a poison so toxic that Pokémon as large as Wailord will still be suffering three days after it first takes effect.

species.name: Mudbray
species.flavor: It eats dirt to create mud and smears this mud all over its feet, giving them the grip needed to walk on rough terrain without slipping.

species.name: Mudsdale
species.flavor: Mudsdale has so much stamina that it could carry over 10 tons across the Galar region without rest or sleep.

species.name: Dewpider
species.flavor: Dewpider normally lives underwater. When it comes onto land in search of food, it takes water with it in the form of a bubble on its head.

species.name: Araquanid
species.flavor: It acts as a caretaker for Dewpider, putting them inside its bubble and letting them eat any leftover food.

species.name: Fomantis
species.flavor: During the day, Fomantis basks in sunlight and sleeps peacefully. It wakes and moves around at night.

species.name: Lurantis
species.flavor: The petals on this Pokémon’s arms are thin and super sharp, and they can fire laser beams if Lurantis gathers light first.

species.name: Morelull
species.flavor: Morelull live in forests that stay dark even during the day. They scatter flickering spores that put enemies to sleep.

species.name: Shiinotic
species.flavor: If you see a light deep in a forest at night, don’t go near. Shiinotic will make you fall fast asleep.

species.name: Salandit
species.flavor: This sneaky Pokémon will slink behind its prey and immobilize it with poisonous gas before the prey even realizes Salandit is there.

species.name: Salazzle
species.flavor: The winner of competitions between Salazzle is decided by which one has the most male Salandit with it.

species.name: Stufful
species.flavor: The way it protects itself by flailing its arms may be an adorable sight, but stay well away. This is flailing that can snap thick tree trunks.

species.name: Bewear
species.flavor: The moves it uses to take down its prey would make a martial artist jealous. It tucks subdued prey under its arms to carry them to its nest.

species.name: Bounsweet
species.flavor: When under attack, it secretes a sweet and delicious sweat. The scent only calls more enemies to it.

species.name: Steenee
species.flavor: Any Corvisquire that pecks at this Pokémon will be greeted with a smack from its sepals followed by a sharp kick.

species.name: Tsareena
species.flavor: A kick from the hardened tips of this Pokémon’s legs leaves a wound in the opponent’s body and soul that will never heal.

species.name: Comfey
species.flavor: These Pokémon smell very nice. All Comfey wear different flowers, so each of these Pokémon has its own individual scent.

species.name: Oranguru
species.flavor: It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.

species.name: Passimian
species.flavor: Passimian live in groups of about 20, with each member performing an assigned role. Through cooperation, the group survives.

species.name: Wimpod
species.flavor: Wimpod gather in swarms, constantly on the lookout for danger. They scatter the moment they detect an enemy’s presence.

species.name: Golisopod
species.flavor: They live in sunken ships or in holes in the seabed. When Golisopod and Grapploct battle, the loser becomes the winner’s meal.

species.name: Sandygast
species.flavor: Sandygast mainly inhabits beaches. It takes control of anyone who puts their hand into its mouth, forcing them to make its body bigger.

species.name: Palossand
species.flavor: This Pokémon lives on beaches, but it hates water. Palossand can’t maintain its castle-like shape if it gets drenched by a heavy rain.

species.name: Pyukumuku
species.flavor: It’s covered in a slime that keeps its skin moist, allowing it to stay on land for days without drying up.

species.name: Type: Null
species.flavor: It was modeled after a mighty Pokémon of myth. The mask placed upon it limits its power in order to keep it under control.

species.name: Silvally
species.flavor: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon’s true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.

species.name: Minior
species.flavor: Although its outer shell is uncommonly durable, the shock of falling to the ground smashes the shell to smithereens.

species.name: Komala
species.flavor: It remains asleep from birth to death as a result of the sedative properties of the leaves that form its diet.

species.name: Turtonator
species.flavor: Eating sulfur in its volcanic habitat is what causes explosive compounds to develop in its shell. Its droppings are also dangerously explosive.

species.name: Togedemaru
species.flavor: When it’s in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.

species.name: Mimikyu
species.flavor: There was a scientist who peeked under Mimikyu’s old rag in the name of research. The scientist died of a mysterious disease.

species.name: Bruxish
species.flavor: Its skin is thick enough to fend off Mareanie’s spikes. With its robust teeth, Bruxish crunches up the spikes and eats them.

species.name: Drampa
species.flavor: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it’s angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

species.name: Dhelmise
species.flavor: After lowering its anchor, it waits for its prey. It catches large Wailord and drains their life-force.

species.name: Jangmo-o
species.flavor: Jangmo-o strikes its scales to communicate with others of its kind. Its scales are actually fur that’s become as hard as metal.

species.name: Hakamo-o
species.flavor: Before attacking its enemies, it clashes its scales together and roars. Its sharp claws shred the opposition.

species.name: Kommo-o
species.flavor: Certain ruins have paintings of ancient warriors wearing armor made of Kommo-o scales.

species.name: Tapu Koko
species.flavor: The lightning-wielding guardian deity of Melemele, Tapu Koko is brimming with curiosity and appears before people from time to time.

species.name: Tapu Lele
species.flavor: Although called a guardian deity, Tapu Lele is devoid of guilt about its cruel disposition and can be described as nature incarnate.

species.name: Tapu Bulu
species.flavor: It makes ringing sounds with its tail to let others know where it is, avoiding unneeded conflicts. This guardian deity of Ula’ula controls plants.

species.name: Tapu Fini
species.flavor: Although it’s called a guardian deity, terrible calamities sometimes befall those who recklessly approach Tapu Fini.

species.name: Cosmog
species.flavor: Cosmog is very curious but not very cautious, often placing itself in danger. If things start to look dicey, it teleports away.

species.name: Cosmoem
species.flavor: It sucks in dust from the air at an astounding rate, frantically building up energy within its core as preparation for evolution.

species.name: Solgaleo
species.flavor: Solgaleo was once known as the Beast That Devours the Sun. Energy in the form of light radiates boundlessly from it.

species.name: Lunala
species.flavor: It steals the light from its surroundings and then becomes the full moon, showering its own light across the night sky.

species.name: Nihilego
species.flavor: It appeared in this world from an Ultra Wormhole. Nihilego appears to be a parasite that lives by feeding on people and Pokémon.

species.name: Buzzwole
species.flavor: Buzzwole goes around showing off its abnormally swollen muscles. It is one kind of Ultra Beast.

species.name: Pheromosa
species.flavor: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

species.name: Xurkitree
species.flavor: They’ve been dubbed Ultra Beasts. Some of them stand unmoving, like trees, with their arms and legs stuck into the ground.

species.name: Celesteela
species.flavor: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

species.name: Kartana
species.flavor: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

species.name: Guzzlord
species.flavor: An unknown life-form called a UB. It may be constantly hungry—it is certainly always devouring something.

species.name: Necrozma
species.flavor: It needs light to survive, and it goes on a rampage seeking it out. Its laser beams will cut anything to pieces.

species.name: Magearna
species.flavor: Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.

species.name: Marshadow
species.flavor: This Pokémon can conceal itself in any shadow, so it went undiscovered for a long time.

species.name: Poipole
species.flavor: An Ultra Beast that lives in a different world, it cackles wildly as it sprays its opponents with poison from the needles on its head.

species.name: Naganadel
species.flavor: One kind of Ultra Beast, it fires a glowing, venomous liquid from its needles. This liquid is also immensely adhesive.

species.name: Stakataka
species.flavor: When stone walls started moving and attacking, the brute’s true identity was this mysterious life-form, which brings to mind an Ultra Beast.

species.name: Blacephalon
species.flavor: A UB that appeared from an Ultra Wormhole, it causes explosions, then takes advantage of opponents’ surprise to rob them of their vitality.

species.name: Zeraora
species.flavor: Electricity sparks from the pads on its limbs. Wherever Zeraora runs, lightning flashes and thunder echoes.

species.name: Meltan
species.flavor: They live as a group, but when the time comes, one strong Meltan will absorb all the others and evolve.

species.name: Melmetal
species.flavor: Centrifugal force is behind the punches of Melmetal’s heavy hex-nut arms. Melmetal is said to deliver the strongest punches of all Pokémon.
